title: SN TOOL - Official Update v2.0.6 (Studio Pro Audio, 100% Khmer Dubbing & Offline STT)
subtitle: Major update featuring Studio Pro Audio Limiter, 10x Parallel TTS with Clarity EQ, 100% Khmer Dubbing Translation Guarantee, and Offline Faster-Whisper STT Fallback.
release_notes:
• 🎙️ Studio Pro Audio & Limiter: Built-in soft-knee limiter (-1.2 dBFS), adaptive lip-sync time-stretching up to 1.65x, and warm BGM preservation with intelligent ducking.
• ⚡ High-Speed Parallel TTS Engine: Upgraded to 10 parallel workers with Studio Clarity EQ (75Hz HPF, 3.2k/8.5k air presence, compression) and ZWSP Edge-TTS error recovery.
• 🌐 100% Khmer Dubbing Translation: Ultra-reliable Google Batch failover (25 lines/call) with strict CJK & Pinyin filtering guaranteeing 0% untranslated Chinese lines.
• 🧠 Smart Offline STT Fallback: Seamless automatic fallback to local Faster-Whisper when cloud STT is unavailable.
• 🛡️ Media Decoding Robustness: Added automatic FFmpeg MP3 container fallback for ID3 metadata compatibility.
